title: Sects, new movements and high-control groups
tagline: Adventists and the Sabbath, Oneness Pentecostals, the prosperity gospel, and how to care for someone in a high-control group.
whyItMatters: Many people find meaning and community in groups that teach error, and a few are caught in control. Knowing the difference helps you answer kindly and care wisely.

mindset.tip: Meet the person first; most join for community and meaning, not for doctrine. (1 Peter 3:15-16; CCC 856)
Do not label every strict or odd group a cult. Ask whether there is real control of information, relationships and conscience.
Learn what the group says in its own words before you reply.
Offer patient friendship and an open door; never force a person out. (Luke 15:20)
Answer the hunger that drew them: welcome, belonging and a clear call. (CCC 2113-2117)
